beschreibung: G9a (#319): Quartett-Set weltraum, ein Bild je Karte (Anki-Medien, #270). Sachlich richtig; jede Auswahl gegen die Quelle der Karte prüfen.
stil: Painterly astronomical illustration in oil colours, like a plate from a royal astronomer's star atlas: one celestial body as a sphere centred against a deep midnight-blue starry background, lit from the upper left, surface painted after its real known appearance. No spacecraft, no labels, no constellation lines, no text.
ohne: text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, border, frame, card layout, modern objects, logos, photo
